title: Services
metaDescription: Four divisions: civil and infrastructure, water resources, electrical and mechanical, and energy. Each draws on Sato's shared project management, equipment fleet and HSE systems.

labels.groupEngineeringIntro: The disciplines Sato has delivered with since 1997, in-house and with its own plant.
labels.groupEnergyIntro: Engineering for power and hydrocarbon assets, delivered with technical partners.
labels.groupTechnologyIntro: Asset data, digital models and applied engineering research.

body: Eight services across three groups, one standard of delivery. Every service draws on the same project management, plant and HSE systems Sato has built since 1997.

sections.heading: Backed by Sato
sections.intro: Whichever division delivers your project, the same plant, people and systems stand behind it.

items.label: Projects
items.body: Forty years of delivered work for federal and state government, universities, the World Bank and private clients.

items.label: Health, safety, environment and quality
items.body: Sato operates its own safety management system. It is implemented on every project and audited internally every three months.

sections.body: Working on a project in civil, water or energy infrastructure? Talk to our team.

sections.heading: For procurement and vendor verification
sections.body: Sato is registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission as RC 317208 and its engineers are COREN-registered. We will supply registration documents, referees and a capability statement on request.
